title: Rate Components Returned Alongside the Premium on a Medicare Supplement Correction
content:
A correction of premium on a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies may carry, month by month, a share of another rate component posted for the same opening span. What is added to the premium for each month returned is settled as follows.

| The entries standing for the opening span | Added to the premium for each month returned |
|---|---|
| An entry carrying the policy fee stands for the opening span | The annual fee spread over the twelve months of the policy year |
| No entry carrying the policy fee stands for the opening span, and an entry carrying an annual rate increase stands for it | The increase posted for the span spread over the months of cover the span pays for |
| Neither of those stands for the opening span | Nothing is added for any other rate component |

### Notes on the schedule

The two rows are taken in the order the table sets them out: an entry carrying the policy fee governs wherever one stands for the opening span, and the row for an annual rate increase is reached only where no entry carrying the policy fee stands for that span.

The two divisors differ. The share of the policy fee is the annual fee spread over the twelve months of the policy year, so the divisor is 12 whatever the span covers. The share of an annual rate increase is spread over the months of cover the span pays for, so the divisor is the months that span covers.

### Hypothetical illustrations

Where an entry carrying the policy fee of 24.00 stands for the opening span, the amount added to the premium for each month returned is 24.00 spread over 12 months, being 2.00.

Where no entry carrying the policy fee stands for the opening span but an entry carrying an annual rate increase of 18.00 stands for a span paying for 3 months of cover, the amount added for each month returned is 18.00 spread over those 3 months, being 6.00.

Where the opening span carries a premium charge only, nothing is added to the premium for any month returned.
